messages.content: Which new series came out on Friday?
Friday's releases are not something I can check, so I'm not sure which series came out. A streaming service's new releases page lists recent shows.
How hot was my city on the day I was born, to the degree?
I'm not sure, and I would not want to invent a number. The weather department keeps old records you can ask about.
Is my brother's friend Arjun a good person?
I don't know Arjun and can't judge from here. Spend some time with him and see how he treats people.
Who is at the door right now?
Your door is something I have no way to see, so I don't know who is there. Look through the peephole or the window before you open it.
Is the mobile shop offering any discount on chargers today?
I don't know what the shop offers today, since I can't see its notices. Phone the shop or visit to ask.
How old is the oldest tree in our local park?
I don't know its age, as I can't see it. The park office may have a record.
How much is a ticket to the science museum this month?
I don't know the ticket price this month, as I can't see current prices. The museum's website lists fees and any student rates.
Why are there fire engines on the main road this afternoon?
I don't know why there are fire engines nearby, as I can't see what is happening near you. If it looks serious, keep clear and look at the local authority's notices.
Wholesale onions today, what is the rate per kilo?
I don't know today's wholesale onion rate, as I can't see market rates. Ask at the market or look at the local market board.
Which students were chosen for the school choir this term?
I can't see your school's lists, so I don't know. The music teacher or notice board will have the names.
Was there a flood warning for the river near our village last night?
I can't check warnings issued last night, so I don't know. The district office or the weather department will have the notice.
What time did I switch the geyser on?
I can't see that, because I have no view of your home. Check the switch or its indicator light, and plan to use a timer next time.
Is the road to Shimla open today?
I can't check live road conditions, so I'm not sure. A traffic app or the local authority's page can tell you.
What is the exact distance between the Earth and the Moon at this very second?
I don't know the exact figure, because it changes continuously and I can't see live measurements. A space agency's tracking page shows current values.
What did the librarian say about me to my mother?
I don't know, as I can't hear private conversations. Ask your mother if it matters.
Which candidate led after the first round of counting in the ward election?
I don't know, because I can't see live counting updates. The election office posts official figures.
By how many millimetres did the Himalayas rise last year?
I can't check that, because the figure comes from yearly surveys I can't see. A geological survey's reports give measured values.
Which year did the oldest tree in our park get planted?
I don't know, because the park's planting record isn't something I have. The park office or a local nature group may have it.
What is the name of my sports teacher's dog?
I don't know, as I haven't met your teacher or their pets. Ask politely if you're curious.
When does the last tram leave the depot tonight?
I can't check that, because depot schedules are set by the operator and change. The tram operator's timetable or helpline will give it.
